root_cause_review.feedback: The Proposed Root Cause and Supporting Evidence sections are completely empty. There is no root cause statement to evaluate for consistency with the CVE/commit message, and there is no evidence to verify for sufficiency. A proper root cause analysis must include at minimum: (1) a clear statement of the vulnerability's root cause explaining WHY the bug occurred, not just WHAT was fixed; and (2) specific evidence from the patch/CVE that supports this analysis. Both are missing here.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix device teardown by notifying pending data exchange operations of device removal.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check for the NCI_DATA_EXCHANGE flag within nci_close_device; if set, invokes nci_data_exchange_complete with -ENODEV error code.
intent_record.how: Ensures that any pending data exchange operations are explicitly notified of device closure with an error status, preventing hangs or undefined states during teardown.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix device close routine to terminate pending data exchanges and clean up the data timer.
intent_record.what: Added timer_delete_sync for ndev->data_timer and a conditional check for NCI_DATA_EXCHANGE flag to invoke nci_data_exchange_complete with -ENODEV inside nci_close_device.
intent_record.how: Ensures the data timer is stopped and any active data exchange sessions are forcibly completed with an error code during device closure, preventing hangs or resource leaks.

grouping_result.intent: Fix device close routine to terminate pending data exchanges and clean up the data timer.

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix device close and teardown routines to terminate pending data exchanges and clean up associated timers.
